limitations: Auth/D1 and tax provider observations are synthetic; no real Stripe account or provider call is claimed.
PGlite PostgreSQL WASM is serialized: no multi-connection/load/crash/SLA or hosted readiness claim.
Browser interaction recipe uses the real memory V5 kernel with synthetic data; separate SQL scenarios validate the migration chain and persistence.
A TEST tax calculation is not a tax transaction, general compliance certification or US GAAP certification.
Current supported scope is taxable exclusive services, whole positive quantities, US destination, USD and accrual.
No hosted migration, public US activation, native admission/installer publication, customer data or Swiss business-source change.
Targeted/backend/contract/browser unit counts overlap the global regression and must not be added to its total.
